language.label: Language
language.title: Interface language
language.intro: Choose the language Ticknest uses for you. Other workspace members keep their own language.
language.saved: Language saved. It will follow you on any device you sign in to.
language.saveFailed: We couldn’t save your language. Check your connection and try again.

auth.heroTitle: Make room for <highlight>the work that matters.</highlight>
auth.heroBody: Track time with a team workspace that lives in your own Firebase project.
auth.heroFooter: Open source · Self-hosted · No seat limits
auth.introReset: We’ll email you a secure link to choose a new password.
auth.introSignUp: Start a workspace for your team in just a moment.
auth.introSignIn: Sign in to continue to your workspace.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailAlreadyInUse: An account already exists for this email. Sign in instead.
errors.invalidCredential: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.networkRequestFailed: Ticknest couldn’t reach Firebase Authentication. Check your internet connection and try again. If you use a VPN, firewall, or privacy extension, make sure it allows this site to connect to Firebase.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a password with at least 6 characters.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.userDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact the workspace administrator.
errors.unauthorizedDomain: This site is not authorized for Firebase sign-in. Add its domain in Firebase Authentication settings.
errors.requiresRecentLogin: Sign in again before deleting your account.
errors.missingPassword: Enter your password to confirm account deletion.
errors.userMismatch: Choose the Google account you signed in with, then try deleting your account again.
errors.popupClosedByUser: Google sign-in was closed before it finished.
errors.popupBlocked: Allow pop-ups for this site, then try Google sign-in again.
errors.operationNotAllowed: This sign-in method is not enabled in Firebase Authentication.
errors.accountExistsWithDifferentCredential: An account already exists with this email. Sign in with your original method, then link Google in account settings.
errors.functionsInternal: The workspace service is not available in this Firebase project yet. Deploy the Firebase Functions, then try again.
errors.functionsNotFound: The workspace service is not deployed in this Firebase project. Deploy the Firebase Functions, then try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You do not have access to this workspace.
errors.authFallback: We couldn’t sign you in. Please try again. If the problem continues, check the Firebase Authentication settings.
errors.busy: Ticknest is busy or unreachable right now. Check your connection and try again in a few minutes.
errors.busyDemo: The public demo is busy or unreachable right now. Try again in a few minutes, or run your own copy from {{url}}.
